How this shortlist works

These nine configurations were researched from exact retailer listings on October 11, 2026. They illustrate different component disclosures and platforms; they are not ranked as the best deal. Prices and availability remain unverified until a connected source supplies eligible observations.

Unknown parts are shown on each detail page. No sale discount, FPS result or independent system test is inferred from a listing. Shipping, tax and return terms can change and depend on the seller. No paid placement is included in this cohort.
